# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Adjacent is alpha software. Only the latest release is supported — older alpha versions do not receive back-ported security fixes.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

### Non-sensitive reports

For general bug reports or feature requests, open a [regular GitHub issue](https://github.com/nonrational/adjacent/issues).

### Sensitive security reports

For security vulnerabilities, please use GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting feature](https://github.com/nonrational/adjacent/security/advisories/new) rather than opening a public issue. This allows you to report the vulnerability privately so it can be addressed before public disclosure.

Do not send security reports via email.
